incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - customer 'Sigma Financial' (VPC dedicated pool). Symptoms: 15% 5XX rate, median p50 latency +350ms, GPU OOM signals. Incident ID INC-20260317-5473. Pager routed to @maya-oncall.
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing traces and top-level metrics. @Sam (SRE) can you check infra (host/eviction) and routing?
Sam (SRE): On it. pulling eviction logs and host error counts. starting runbook `vpc-dedicated-failover`.
Leah (eng-runtime): Quick note from runtime traces: KV cache miss spikes + rapid GPU memory fragmentation around 03:12 UTC. We saw repeated partial OOMs on model variant `v2.1-quant` in pool `sigma-dedicated-1`. Suspect this variant's memory pattern under the current prompt distribution is causing instability.
Omar (Customer Success): Customer reports users getting failed completions and timeouts. They're actively monitoring their support queue.
Maya (oncall): Proposed mitigation: 1) Pin Sigma tenant to safe variant `v2.0-stable` 2) Configure soft fallback to `v1.9-legacy` for any degraded nodes 3) Throttle concurrent sessions for the tenant to 80% for 15m 4) Monitor metrics/traces for 30m. Thoughts?
Leah (eng-runtime): +1 to pin. `v2.0-stable` has a proven memory profile. We should avoid full rollback to `v1.9` unless regressions show up. Also capture a HEAP/OOM dump from one affected host before rotating to aid postmortem.
Sam (SRE): Executing pin via admin API now.
Sam (SRE): ```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/tenants/sigma/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"v2.0-stable","safeFallback":"v1.9-legacy","concurrentLimitPct":80,"reason":"OOM+latency spike 03:12 UTC"}'
```
Sam (SRE): Pin applied - 200 OK. Config propagated to pool `sigma-dedicated-1` (change-id cfg-87321). Now enabling soft-fallback routing and throttling.
deploy-bot: routing-change recorded: cfg-87321, rollout=immediate, actor=sam-sre.
Maya (oncall): Monitoring dashboard: 5XX down from 15% -> 6% in last 3 mins, p50 latency dropped ~220ms. Customer CS (Omar) says failures visible but reduced. Keeping open while we watch for 30m.
Omar (Customer Success): I've messaged Sigma. They confirmed reduced failures and appreciate the rapid mitigation. Asking for ETA to return to original `v2.1-quant` variant.
Leah (eng-runtime): We'll need to repro the OOM in staging with the same prompt mix and sequence length distribution. Estimate 48-72h to validate fixes (or tune quantization) and re-roll. Will log required tests to ticket RDW-3129.
Kai (Product): Please include an item in the postmortem: guardrail to auto-detect OOM trend and auto-pin to a safe variant for affected tenants (Optimize rule).
Leah (eng-runtime): Agreed - filing a short epic for detect-and-pin automation after the incident.
Maya (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll keep incident lead for 30m stabilization window, then hand to daytime oncall @Niko at 11:00 UTC. Niko, you'll have the mitigation summary and change-id cfg-87321.
Niko (oncall): Acknowledged, will take over at 11:00 UTC and monitor for any rollback signals.
Sam (SRE): Captured HEAP dumps from two nodes before rotation and uploaded to S3 at s3://rdw-incidents/inc-5473/dumps/. Saved logs and traces to the incident bundle.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-20260317-5473 status update: mitigation applied (tenant pinned to v2.0-stable, safeFallback v1.9-legacy), priority P2, participants: Maya, Sam, Leah, Omar, Kai.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. I'll convert this to an incident ticket with timeline and assign postmortem to Leah+Sam+Product. Closing after stabilization window if metrics stay good. :white_check_mark:
